title: Real loop-back support in processes
description: Enable processes to jump back to a previous step based on conditions or agent decisions, supporting iterative workflows. Currently step execution is strictly linear (forward-only by array index). This would add explicit flow-control fields to the step schema (e.g. loopBackTo, loopCondition, maxIterations) and update the process-continue logic to reset a target step's status and redirect execution backward. Must include loop-depth guards to prevent infinite cycles.
author: matanha@payoneer.com
